messages:
sam.sales: Quick sync — Globex ready to buy but procurement flagged two blockers: (1) DPA needs HSM/KMS proof, (2) Net60 payment terms require exec countersign. they asked if we can give a short trial before PO. looping legal/finance/eng.

emma.legal: On it. Legal wants to: a) cap liability in Sec 11, b) add DPA exhibit for HSM attestation + subprocessor notice, c) ensure countersign on Net60 is documented. please attach their security contact.

globex.poc: Confirmed. Our security team requires an attestation showing key separation and either vendor HSM cert or an HSM integration checklist. Procurement can approve a 10-day non-billable trial after countersign or a 7-day trial if countersign is pending.

li.engineering: We can run a Private POC in their VPC and connect to their KMS or bind Dedicated with HSM. Ops needs KMS endpoint, cert and an IAM mapping. ETA ~48 hours after we get artifacts. i'll prepare the HSM checklist and a tiny arch diagram.

ana.finance: Net60 without PO needs VP waiver. Finance will accept Net60 if: (1) countersign triggers first invoice, (2) billing contact present, and (3) AR notified. Otherwise require PO before provisioning.

pat.solutions: Proposed middle ground: sign MSA + orderform with clause: "Limited trial provisioning (7 days) on execution; continued provisioning contingent on PO within 30 days; failure to provide PO results in suspension of trial resources only." keeps both sides safe.

docsignbot: Template flow: Orderform -> Sales sign -> Exec countersign -> DocuSign envelope OF-1780002222. MSA redline -> Legal finalize -> MSA-1780002222. Upload PDFs to proceed.

emma.legal: i'll draft the amendment and DPA exhibit today and request the compliance HSM attestation template. once uploaded i'll share envelope ids.

li.engineering: +1, will post checklist and diagram here ASAP. ops note: please provide certs to ops@redwood.com.

sam.sales: Great. Actions: @emma.legal upload redlines & DPA exhibit, @ana.finance confirm invoice milestone language, @li.engineering attach HSM checklist, i'll create DocuSign envelopes and send to purchasing@globex.com cc secops@globex.com. Thanks :thumbsup:
